name: 3dof_text_pick_up_the_pen
prompt: [CAMERA STATE] STATIC CAMERA: Top-down at 1.5m height CAMERA VELOCITY = 0 FOV: Wide enough to capture workspace [ACTION - SINGLE ARM MANIPULATION] Starting pose: Gripper at the center of the table, facing the pen Motion sequence: - t=0-1s: The gripper moves smoothly forward at 0.5 cm/s towards the pen. - t=1-2s: The gripper accelerates to 1 cm/s as it approaches the pen. - t=2-3s: The gripper precisely grasps the pen, applying a gentle force of 0.1 N. - t=3-5s: The gripper lifts the pen, completing the task smoothly without any jerky movements. Target: The pen is lifted off the table, held by the gripper, and placed back on the table. [PHYSICS] - Smooth acceleration: 0 → 0.5 cm/s over 1 second - Gravity: Pen remains stable when gripped - Workspace limit: 50 cm radius - Realistic joint speeds
negative_prompt: 6 DOF motion, complex wrist articulation, unrealistic speed, teleportation, object morphing, floating objects ignoring gravity, workspace boundary violations, collision with environment, gripper slipping, shaky camera, motion blur during precision tasks, poor lighting, out of focus, jerky motion, unrealistic acceleration.
